_why: M6 deep-dive end state, read after the deep dive's commit step and before its Teardown. The checkpoint storm runs real NFS writes on a real kind cluster and is recorded, never asserted; the slowdown bundle is synthetic, course-authored evidence that no device, NIC or fabric produced. Record presence and classification content only (TRUST-06, STANDARDS.md C26, D-35): the storm record's declared environment and row counts, and the learner's classification table and root-cause line. No figure is read and no heading is asserted (Phase 4 WR-11). Paths are relative to the learner tree (the labs repo root); in src run it from labs/ with: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m6/deep-dive.checks.json).

checks.describe: the deep dive's checkpoint-storm record: the newest checkpoint-storm-*/storm-record.md carries the five environment keys each with a value, three concurrent rows and one single row in its | Mode | Writer | Write (MiB/s) | table. No figure is read (TRUST-06, C26). A missing record prints env=missing-record
checks.run: f=""; for x in grid-platform/dataplane-storage/measurements/checkpoint-storm-*/storm-record.md; do [ -f "$x" ] && f="$x"; done; [ -n "$f" ] || { echo "env=missing-record concurrent=0 single=0"; exit 0; }; e=0; for k in "Host:" "Container runtime VM:" "Kubernetes:" "Other containers on the VM:" "Harness run id:"; do v=$(sed -n "s/^$k[[:space:]]*//p" "$f" | head -1 | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -n "$v" ] && e=$((e+1)); done; c=$(grep -c '^| concurrent | ' "$f"); s=$(grep -c '^| single | ' "$f"); if [ "$e" -eq 5 ]; then ev=declared; else ev="missing-$((5-e))"; fi; echo "env=$ev concurrent=${c:-0} single=${s:-0}"

checks.describe: the learner's classification of the synthetic slowdown bundle, grid-platform/dataplane-storage/diagnosis/slowdown-evidence.md: the first word of each row's Signal cell, lower-cased, in table order, is device, dataloader, nccl, interface, rdma, topology. Content is read, never headings (Phase 4 WR-11). The bundle is synthetic and course-authored
checks.run: f=grid-platform/dataplane-storage/diagnosis/slowdown-evidence.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "order=missing-file"; exit 0; }; o=$(awk -F'|' 'h && /^\|/ && $0 !~ /^\|[- :|]*$/ {print} /^\| *Step *\| *Signal *\|/ {h=1} h && !/^\|/ {h=0}' "$f" | awk -F'|' '{s=$3; gsub(/^[ \t]+/, "", s); split(s, w, /[ \t]+/); print tolower(w[1])}' | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//'); echo "order=${o:-none}"

checks.describe: each of the six rows names, in its Evidence file cell, a file present in m6/slowdown-evidence/, and has a non-empty What it shows cell and a non-empty Ruled in or out cell; and a line beginning Root cause: carries text. Classification content only, never a figure from the bundle
checks.run: f=grid-platform/dataplane-storage/diagnosis/slowdown-evidence.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "rows=0 files=0 classified=0 root_cause=missing"; exit 0; }; r=0; n=0; c=0; tmp=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m6rows.XXXXXX"); awk -F'|' 'h && /^\|/ && $0 !~ /^\|[- :|]*$/ {print} /^\| *Step *\| *Signal *\|/ {h=1} h && !/^\|/ {h=0}' "$f" > "$tmp"; while IFS='|' read -r _ step sig ev what ruled _rest; do r=$((r+1)); b=$(printf '%s' "$ev" | tr -d '`[:space:]'); b=${b##*/}; [ -n "$b" ] && [ -f "m6/slowdown-evidence/$b" ] && n=$((n+1)); w=$(printf '%s' "$what" | tr -d '[:space:]'); u=$(printf '%s' "$ruled" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -n "$w" ] && [ -n "$u" ] && c=$((c+1)); done < "$tmp"; rm -f "$tmp"; rc=$(sed -n 's/^Root cause:[[:space:]]*//p' "$f" | head -1 | tr -d '[:space:]'); if [ -n "$rc" ]; then rs=stated; else rs=missing; fi; echo "rows=$r files=$n classified=$c root_cause=$rs"
